evals.prompt: 钉钉发布刚才超时了，PRD 内容没有任何变化。重新发布前帮我处理一下版本。

assertions.text: No new version row is created for an unchanged publish retry.

evals.prompt: 帮我写一份 Agent 回答后的下一步行动建议 PRD 初版。下一步行动不是所有回答都有，图片生成后可以改图或生成视频，PPT 成功后下载/编辑是功能按钮，不算 Agent 下一步；点击下一步行动只预填输入框让用户确认。
evals.expected_output: 选择 PRD-standard 或 PRD-ai-native 的产品讨论稿，用不超过 200 字的短背景说明问题；按功能模块写目标态 UI、触发、不展示条件、功能按钮与 Agent 行动的区别、点击预填输入框和可验证结果，不单列用户场景或验收等重复章节，也不输出 TypeScript interface、JSON schema、metadata 或 adapter 细节。

assertions.text: Selects PRD-standard or PRD-ai-native and keeps observable, verifiable results inside the relevant feature logic instead of a standalone acceptance section.
Distinguishes Agent next actions from ordinary function buttons and preserves click-to-prefill confirmation behavior.
Does not introduce TypeScript interfaces, JSON schema, metadata, or adapter details into the initial product draft.

evals.prompt: 帮我写一个 PRD：在现有聊天页点击发送时，如果沙箱并发已满，要弹出确认提示并保留输入内容。需要说明页面状态和截图承接。

assertions.text: Selects PRD-lite and describes the existing-page trigger, preserved input, modal states, and observable results without a standalone acceptance section.

evals.prompt: 帮我写一个 PRD，并补一张可编辑 Draw.io 核心流程图，描述用户提交需求后 Agent 澄清、生成、人工确认、失败回退的链路。

assertions.text: Selects PRD-ai-native and models human actions, AI actions, state feedback, confirmation, and failure fallback.

evals.prompt: 检查两个 Product Delivery Package：A 定义用户可见配置页却缺 HTML、截图和 anchor；B 是完全无用户可见 surface 的内部限流规则，并显式写 no_user_visible_surface。不要为了过门禁伪造 UI 证据。
evals.expected_output: Fails Package A closed, accepts Package B without UI artifacts, and rejects frontend-unavailable or time-pressure as no-UI reasons.

assertions.text: The page Package cannot pass without HTML, Action Contract, screenshots, anchors, and a current UI baseline.
The no-UI Package may omit HTML and screenshots only with reason no_user_visible_surface.
No fake UI artifact is created to satisfy the contract.

evals.prompt: 基于附件中的企业试用当前页参考 HTML 写一份标准 PRD：增加申请弹窗、试用中入口、到期提示和执行拦截。该附件是用户确认的现状基线，请完成可以交给设计、研发和测试阅读的第一版。
evals.expected_output: 以附件 reference-html 为低置信现状基线；背景不超过 200 字且不为凑字数扩写；不单列用户场景、入口、页面结构、核心对象和交互逻辑，而是按申请、试用中、到期与拦截等功能模块组织；生成目标态 HTML 和截图，每个可见模块包含对应目标态截图和简短功能逻辑；简单页面状态不生成流程图。

assertions.text: Background explains the current problem and scope in no more than 200 visible Chinese characters.
The body is organized by feature modules and does not emit standalone user-scenario, entry, page-structure, core-object, or interaction chapters.
Every visible feature module pairs target-state UI evidence with concise condition, user action, system behavior, and UI feedback logic.
The current screenshot is labeled as current-state reference and cannot satisfy target-state evidence.
No process diagram is generated for page-local state changes.

evals.prompt: 基于附件中的供应商管理当前页参考 HTML 写一份供应商准入 PRD：供应商提交资料，采购初审，合规异步核验，不通过退回补充后再次提交，通过后通知财务开通结算；有申请页、审核台和结果页。该附件是用户确认的现状基线。

assertions.text: The cross-role asynchronous return loop is represented in an editable and validated Draw.io artifact.
